reviewer_profile: Skeptical EMNLP reviewer focused on algorithmic precision, hidden assumptions, and operationalization
summary: Proposes PATD: decentralized multi-agent delegation on fixed topologies via accept-or-forward routing, structured handoff packets, and terminal-consensus peer backpropagation (TCPB). Core claim: fixed structure + outcome-driven competence calibration yields stable delegation without central orchestrator. Document is unusually explicit about parameters and honest about limitations, but key algorithmic primitives remain undefined and hard-coded safety priors undermine self-organization claims.
top_strengths: Exceptional parameter-level specificity: scoring functions, thresholds, and update rules are numerically pinned down
